This document outlines the equipment inspection list 
 I1, to be performed on an annually bases as indicated by Y1 in the above title block.

The tubular 
 feed water heater is used to heat boiler feed water flowing through the tubes, 
 using steam bled from turbine stage on the shell side

The first 
 draft initiated by eng. Sameh 
 Ibrahem kamall, 
 reviewed by maintenance manager eng. Ahmed Abdel Rrahman, tested

This document accepted by eng. 
 Samir 
 Abdel Gilel: EDEPC inspection and quality control general director & MPIS 
 coordinator, and 
 certified by accountant Mahmoud Mohamed Soliman: EDEPC planning & 
 financial prediction head sector and supervisor of inspection & quality 
 control's head sector.

A work permit must be issued and the maintenance staff should carry 
 the suitable safety category.

Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is 
 required.

Wear safety and healthy equipment as safety helmet, 
 safety shoes, hearing protection ... etc.

items: Isolate the vessel from the feed water system.
Be sure that the heater has been completely drained.
Check the pressure gauge shows zero pressure.
Check thermometers and assure that temperature is less than 40 C.
Provide adequate scaffolding, lighting, platforms or ladders.

Make certain that all safety tags are replaced when maintenance and 
 inspection are complete.

Check 
 any leakage of the flange.

Check level of water in 
 the shell side.

Follow the shut down 
 procedures. After the tube side has been drained the channel cover and
 plate cover should be removed to expose the 
 tube end.

A hydraulic test should 
 then be put on the shell side not exceeding the test pressure illustrated in 
 the technical specification.

Observe any leak which 
 occurs and mark their location, if there it is necessary to replace the tube 
 or plug both tube's ends.

Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued and the maintenance staff should carry 
 the suitable safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is 
 required.
Wear safety and healthy equipment as safety helmet, 
 safety shoes, hearing protection ... etc.
Isolate the vessel from the feed water system.
Be sure that the heater has been completely drained.
Check the pressure gauge shows zero pressure.
Check thermometers and assure that temperature is less than 40 C.
Provide adequate scaffolding, lighting, platforms or ladders.
Make certain that all safety tags are replaced when maintenance and 
 inspection are complete.
Tools and Equipment
Complete 
 maintenance tool set

 articles (fluid, rags. etc)
Manual puller, Temporary jack
Micro meter, Arc-air gouging
Main crane, 4x6 hard wood blocks

Out

 any leakage of the flange.

Tube Leak Test
Follow the shut down 
 procedures. After the tube side has been drained the channel cover and
 plate cover should be removed to expose the 
 tube end.
A hydraulic test should 
 then be put on the shell side not exceeding the test pressure illustrated in 
 the technical specification.
Observe any leak which 
 occurs and mark their location, if there it is necessary to replace the tube 
 or plug both tube's ends.
NOTE: 
 The number of plugged tubes shouldn't exceed 10% of the tubes number.
